tools.name: check_subreddit_rules
tools.description: Whether a subreddit allows a founder to post, comment, or share a link about their product. Returns a hedged read with its source and date. Input: the subreddit name, with or without r/.

tools.name: validate_idea
tools.description: A scored verdict on a business idea or a live site: who pays, the biggest risk, the cheapest test, with live sources when the daily search budget allows. Input: the idea in one or two sentences, or the site's URL.

tools.name: find_people_asking
tools.description: The real places (subreddits, forums, communities, directories) where the buyers of a business already ask for something like it, each with why, the move to make there, a source URL when live search opened it, and a read on whether posting or commenting is allowed. tools.name: my_new_threads
tools.description: The live threads waiting for a reply on the signed-in user's Kasspian plans, newest first, each with a handle (planId#index), the asker's words, the link, the room read and whether a reply is written.

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.description: The reply Kasspian wrote for one of the user's threads, written to that room's rules, or writes it if none exists yet. Input: the handle from my_new_threads (planId#index). The user posts it themselves; this tool never posts.

tools.name: mark_reply
tools.description: After the user posts a reply from their own account, record it: status sent, then replied, signed_up or paid as it happens, with the Reddit account used and the amount when paid. Feeds the daily thread check, the revenue tally and the webhook. Input: handle (planId#index) and status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_subreddit_rules, validate_idea, find_people_asking, my_new_threads, mark_reply · Private data: mark_reply · Public sink: check_subreddit_rules, mark_reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_subreddit_rules, validate_idea, find_people_asking, my_new_threads, mark_reply · Private data: mark_reply · Public sink: check_subreddit_rules, mark_reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
